# Urban Wünsch

> Assistant Professor, Chalmers University of Technology. Researcher working on organic compounds dissolved in water — disentangling the composition of complex environmental samples to understand the fate of Dissolved Organic Matter (DOM) in aquatic systems. As of late 2026: 34 publications (10 as lead), H-index 19, 2100+ citations.

Personal academic website of Urban Wünsch. The pages below are plain HTML; the CV is also available as structured data.

## Pages

- [About](https://www.ujwunsch.com/): research focus, methods and contact.
- [CV](https://www.ujwunsch.com/cv/): education, positions, research grants, teaching, supervision, conferences and skills.
- [Publications](https://www.ujwunsch.com/publications/): peer-reviewed journal articles with DOIs, sortable by year or citations.
- [Projects](https://www.ujwunsch.com/projects/): funded research grants and long-term research projects.
